Fig. 1: Overview of the evidence verification process in DIVRR. Numerical values denote question-conditioned relevance scores st. Purple boxes indicate observations admitted into the Relevance-guided Memory via Adaptive Admission Control. At waypoint 7, DIVRR triggers View Refinement and performs multi-view augmentation to select the most relevant viewpoint before memory commitment. The final answer is then generated by conditioning on the compact memory, successfully grounding the response to the question.
